mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises by ≥0.25pp, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate investment and economic growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy in an inflationary environment, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise in the same month, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer sector that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive quarters and RSAFS declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal is below 0.03.
